usage.sourcePath: convSendSplitCommand -> focusSplitOwner(B) -> publishMainSelection(next main pane A) -> readConversationPlacement stored main selection -> root thread A. Canonical main selection/provider custody must remain independent of a focused summary owner.

negative.conclusion: Test times out inside existing host first-textarea readiness. Restored right panel narrows the conversation area; responsive split folding shows B and hides first A. Snapshot shows no Usage modal and a Thread memory panel, but explicit negative-case storage/draft/zero-send assertions were not reached.
negative.sourcePath: WorkspaceSplitLayout narrows when available width < minimumSplitSize or <700px, and hides all but the focused pane. A deliberate wider viewport can exercise the requested two-visible-composer restore boundary without changing production layout or deadlines.
